description: This file contains unit tests for the 'execute_async' handler and related functions within the 'handlers' package. It tests various scenarios including queue saturation, webhook handling, agent call responses, timeouts, and header propagation, ensuring the robustness of asynchronous execution handling in the system.

methods.name: TestExecuteAsyncHandler_QueueSaturation
methods.description: Tests the queue saturation behavior of the asynchronous execution handler, verifying proper response when the queue is full.

methods.name: TestExecuteAsyncHandler_WithWebhook
methods.description: Verifies that webhook registration and notification work correctly during asynchronous execution.

methods.name: TestExecuteAsyncHandler_InvalidWebhook
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid webhook URLs during asynchronous execution, expecting registration to fail gracefully.

methods.name: TestHandleSync_AsyncAcknowledgment
methods.description: Simulates an asynchronous acknowledgment during synchronous execution, verifying proper processing and event publishing.

methods.name: TestCallAgent_HTTP202Response
methods.description: Checks that the agent call correctly handles an HTTP 202 Accepted response indicating an asynchronous process.

methods.name: TestCallAgent_ErrorResponse
methods.description: Ensures that error responses from the agent are properly processed and reported.

methods.name: TestCallAgent_Timeout
methods.description: Verifies that request timeouts are handled correctly when the agent delays response beyond the timeout threshold.

methods.name: TestCallAgent_ReadResponseError
methods.description: Tests error handling when reading the agent's response fails due to connection issues.

methods.name: TestCallAgent_HeaderPropagation
methods.description: Checks that context-specific headers are correctly propagated in the agent's HTTP requests.
